description: Server core data layer and agent-facing endpoint: agent-token auth via safeEqual with a separate credential space, the persisted cosmetic alias store (gitignored JSON, atomic serialized writes, corrupt-tolerant), the FleetRegistry (per-agent isolated bounded state, frame handling with departed-metric prune, command routing with correlation, offline handling, bounded live log ring), and the inbound AgentGateway WS endpoint with pre-auth hardening. Depends on FEAT-001 (protocol/correlation) and FEAT-002 only for shared wire types already in FEAT-001; it is otherwise independent of the agent runtime. Covers plan.md items 9-12. Maps to design section 4 and FR-3/FR-8 with AC-22..AC-29, AC-34..AC-40, AC-48..AC-50.
steps: Create src/server/agentAuth.ts: `validate(provided: string, tokens: string[]): boolean` = tokens.some(t => safeEqual(provided, t)) reusing the throw-safe safeEqual from src/api/auth.ts; plus `buildAgentAuthConfig(cfg): { tokens: string[] }` splitting AGENT_TOKENS on ',', trimming, dropping empties, appending AGENT_TOKEN if set, deduping. Add src/server/agentAuth.test.ts (valid token accepted; invalid/missing/empty/wrong-length rejected WITHOUT throwing; list rotation — any entry matches; confirms safeEqual is used).

Add `aliasSchema` to src/api/schemas.ts: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100).refine(no control characters). Export it alongside the request schemas and extend src/api/schemas.test.ts for the alias validation (accepts 1-100 printable trimmed; rejects blank/too-long/control chars).

Create src/server/aliasStore.ts: `class AliasStore` backed by ALIAS_STORE_FILE JSON ({ [agentId]: alias }). load() reads+parses+validates with z.record(z.string(), aliasSchema): missing file -> {}; corrupt/invalid -> warn + {}. get(id)/all(). set(id, alias): validate with aliasSchema (invalid -> throw/return a VALIDATION-mapped error the route turns into 400), SYNCHRONOUSLY update the in-memory map (source of truth), then persist async with a single-in-flight serialized/coalesced write (writing promise + dirty flag, last-writer-wins by in-memory state), each physical write = write-to-temp-then-rename (atomic); write failure logs warn and keeps the in-memory value (never crashes). Unknown agent id -> accept + persist. Inject readFile/writeFile/rename for tests. Add src/server/aliasStore.test.ts (set/get/persist; reload after restart; missing -> empty continue; corrupt JSON/schema -> warn+empty no crash; invalid alias rejected not persisted; unknown id accepted; atomic temp+rename; concurrent set()s coalesce to the LATEST value with an injected slow write — no regression; get() right after set() sees the new value before the write settles; write failure warns + keeps in-memory).

Create src/server/registry.ts: `FleetRegistry` keyed by stable agentId with AgentEntry { id, meta, online, lastSeen, socket, processes: Map<string,ProcessSnapshot>, metrics: per-agent MetricsStore (existing retention/sample semantics), errors: per-agent ErrorTracker (existing buffer semantics), pm2Connected, pending: PendingRequests<ControlResult>, logSubscribers: Map<process, Set<humanClient>> }. Frame handling: snapshot -> replace processes map wholesale, set pm2Connected/online, then PRUNE every metrics series whose name is not in the new snapshot (port MonitorState.onMetricsTick's prune into the snapshot handler); update:transition -> update status + re-emit on the fleet event stream; update:metrics -> push each sample into the agent MetricsStore with ts carried VERBATIM (push only, NO prune); update:error -> feed the agent ErrorTracker + re-emit; update:pm2 -> set pm2Connected; control:response -> entry.pending.settle(cid,result); log:line -> fan out to that process's subscribed human clients. routeControl(agentId, action, name): unknown -> { ok:false, code:'AGENT_NOT_FOUND' }, offline -> { ok:false, code:'AGENT_OFFLINE' } (neither blocks); else cid=newCid, p=pending.create(cid), send control:request/createRequest, return p (resolves on correlated response, 15s AGENT_TIMEOUT, or disconnect AGENT_OFFLINE). On disconnect: online=false, socket=null, pending.rejectAll(AGENT_OFFLINE), clear that agent's logSubscribers, RETAIN the entry, emit a single agent:offline event. Keep each agent's state fully isolated. Maintain a bounded 200-line live log ring per (agentId, process), created on first subscribe and torn down (ref-counted) on last unsubscribe. Add src/server/registry.test.ts (keys by stable id; online/offline transitions; isolation across agents; routeControl correlated result; offline -> AGENT_OFFLINE, unknown -> AGENT_NOT_FOUND, neither blocks; disconnect rejectAll fails in-flight commands; log fan-out to subscribed clients only; metric prune on snapshot drops a departed process's series so processNames/sustainedAbove no longer see it; update:metrics alone does NOT prune; wire ts pushed verbatim).

Create src/server/gateway.ts: `AgentGateway` as a ws WebSocketServer({ noServer:true }) sharing the HTTP server, attaching on server.on('upgrade') and handling ONLY pathname === AGENT_WS_PATH (default /agent) — coexisting with WsHub which already yields on non-/ws paths. Accept the /agent upgrade unconditionally (no secrets in the URL), then require a valid register within a bounded handshake window. On register: compare protocolVersion -> register:nack VERSION_MISMATCH on mismatch (log warn); validate token via agentAuth.validate -> register:nack AUTH_FAILED + close + NO registration on failure; success -> register in FleetRegistry keyed by agentId, send register:ack, mark online. Pre-auth hardening: before auth the ONLY accepted frame is register (any other / decode BAD_MESSAGE -> error:frame + immediate close, no state); a hard NON-EXTENDABLE 5s handshake timeout closes the socket (not reset by malformed frames); a MAX_PENDING_AGENT_SOCKETS cap (default 50) refuses a new /agent upgrade with HTTP/1.1 503 + socket.destroy before constructing a WebSocket; registered agents are not counted; heartbeat/ping-pong timers start only after register:ack. Never log the token or the agent URL — log only { path:'/agent', agentId, authed }. Add src/server/gateway.test.ts (accept on valid register; AUTH_FAILED/VERSION_MISMATCH nack + no registration; handshake-timeout close not reset by a malformed frame; non-register frame before auth -> error:frame + close; reaching the cap refuses the next upgrade with 503-and-destroy and registered agents are not counted; a register with empty token or malformed agentId is rejected at decode before auth; never logs token/url).
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` passes all existing suites plus the new agentAuth, aliasStore, registry, and gateway tests, and the extended schemas test.
Agent tokens use a separate credential space compared via throw-safe safeEqual that never throws on bad input (AC-23/48/49); a token list enables rotation (AC-50).

The alias store persists cosmetic aliases to a JSON file, reloads on restart, tolerates missing/corrupt files, accepts unknown-agent ids, and never regresses to an older value under concurrent writes (AC-34/36/38/39/40).

The FleetRegistry keys state by stable id, keeps agents isolated, routes commands with correlation, returns defined non-blocking errors for offline/unknown, prunes departed metric series on snapshot, and bounds per-agent state (AC-22/24/25/26/27/29, NFR-4).
The gateway authenticates agents on /agent, rejects invalid tokens/versions without registering, and bounds the pre-auth surface (register-only, 5s timeout, pending-socket cap).
Standalone and agent paths remain unaffected.
findings:
Implemented and green: npm run build clean, npm test 283/283 (235 preserved from FEAT-002 + 48 new/extended for FEAT-003). Exact exported names/paths for FEAT-004 (server boot + REST routes + WS relay) to wire:

src/api/schemas.ts: added `export const aliasSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(100).refine(no control chars /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/)`. It is NOT the id charset (an alias is display-only, never routing). Reused by AliasStore AND the future PUT /api/agents/:id/alias route. agentIdSchema already lives in src/protocol/shapes.ts (FEAT-001) — reuse that for :id params and the WS relay agentId validation; no new agentIdSchema was added to schemas.ts.

src/server/agentAuth.ts: `validate(provided: string, tokens: string[]): boolean` = tokens.some(t => safeEqual(provided,t)) (throw-safe; empty list / empty token / wrong length all return false, never throw). `buildAgentAuthConfig(cfg: Pick<AppConfig,'AGENT_TOKENS'|'AGENT_TOKEN'>): { tokens: string[] }` splits AGENT_TOKENS on ',', trims, drops empties, appends AGENT_TOKEN, dedupes (Set). Server boot should call buildAgentAuthConfig(config) and pass .tokens to AgentGateway.

src/server/aliasStore.ts: `class AliasStore({ file, logger, readFile?, writeFile?, rename? })` with async fs injected (defaults node:fs/promises readFile(utf8)/writeFile(utf8)/rename). Methods: `load(): Promise<void>` (missing file -> {}; bad JSON or schema -> logger.warn + {} , never throws), `get(id): string|undefined`, `all(): Record<string,string>` (includes pre-seeded never-connected ids), `set(id, alias): Promise<void>` (validates via aliasSchema; invalid -> throws `AliasValidationError` {code:'VALIDATION'} which the route maps to 400; valid -> SYNC update of the in-memory map (source of truth) then async persist). Persistence is serialized+coalesced (single writing promise + dirty flag, re-flush latest, last-writer-wins by in-memory state) and each physical write is write-to-`${file}.tmp`-then-rename (atomic). Write failure -> logger.warn + keep in-memory (never crashes). Also exported: `AliasValidationError` (name 'AliasValidationError', readonly code 'VALIDATION'), and type aliases ReadFileFn/WriteFileFn/RenameFn. Server boot: `const store = new AliasStore({ file: config.ALIAS_STORE_FILE, logger }); await store.load();` For GET /api/agents, join registry entries with store.get(id); AGENT_NAME arrives as meta.nameHint and should seed the alias only if store.get(id) is undefined.

src/server/registry.ts: `class FleetRegistry({ logger, retentionMin, sampleSec, errorBufferSize, controlTimeoutMs?=15000, now?, setTimer?, clearTimer?, rand? })`. Interfaces exported: `AgentWebSocket { send(data:string):void }` (the minimal server-side socket), `HumanLogClient { deliver(line:LogLineForClient):void }`, `LogLineForClient { agentId, process, stream, level, line, ts }`, `AgentMeta`, `AgentEntry`, `FleetEventMap { 'agent:online':[string]; 'agent:offline':[string] }`. Public API: on/off(fleet events), `ids()`, `get(id):AgentEntry|undefined`, `size`, `onlineCount()`, `register(id, meta, socket):AgentEntry` (reuses a retained entry on reconnect, preserving metrics/errors; emits agent:online), `markOffline(id)` (online=false, socket=null, pm2Connected=false, pending.rejectAll(AGENT_OFFLINE), logRings.clear, retains entry, emits agent:offline), `handleFrame(id, msg: ProtocolMessage)` (dispatches snapshot/update:transition/update:metrics/update:error/update:pm2/control:response/log:line), `routeControl(id, action, name):Promise<ControlResult>`, `routeCreate(id, opts):Promise<ControlResult>` (both: unknown->AGENT_NOT_FOUND, offline->AGENT_OFFLINE, else correlated via PendingRequests with onTimeout->AGENT_TIMEOUT; neither blocks), `subscribeLogs(id, process, streams, client):boolean` / `unsubscribeLogs(id, process, client)` (ref-counted bounded 200-line ring per (id,process); first subscribe sends log:subscribe upstream, last unsubscribe sends log:unsubscribe), `recentLogs(id, process):LogLineForClient[]` (ring snapshot or [] — this backs the server-mode GET .../logs which returns {lines:[]} when nothing is streaming). Snapshot handler PRUNES metric series absent from the snapshot (ported from MonitorState.onMetricsTick); update:metrics PUSHES with wire ts VERBATIM and never prunes. Each AgentEntry owns its own MetricsStore+ErrorTracker+MonitorEvents (per-agent isolation); update:transition/update:error re-emit on entry.events for the agent-aware AlertEngine (FEAT-004). ControlResult codes the server mapper (controlStatus per design §4) must handle: VALIDATION->400, PM2_UNAVAILABLE/AGENT_OFFLINE/AGENT_TIMEOUT->409 (design pins AGENT_TIMEOUT->409; note: FEAT-002 findings cite 504 — reconcile in FEAT-004 against design §4's statusForControlCode which uses 409), AGENT_NOT_FOUND->404, PM2_ERROR/else->502.

src/server/gateway.ts: `class AgentGateway({ server, registry, tokens, wsPath, logger, heartbeatSec?=15, maxPending?=50, now?, setTimer?, clearTimer? })`. Attaches on server.on('upgrade'); handles ONLY pathname===wsPath (yields otherwise, coexisting with WsHub). Exports constants MAX_PENDING_AGENT_SOCKETS=50, HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS=5000, HEARTBEAT_SEC=15 and the `GatewaySocket` interface (extends AgentWebSocket with on('message'|'close'|'error') + close() + optional ping()). Pre-auth: accepts /agent upgrade unconditionally; the ONLY pre-auth frame is register (any other / decode BAD_MESSAGE -> error:frame + close, no state); hard non-extendable 5s handshake timer; MAX_PENDING cap refuses the next upgrade with HTTP/1.1 503 + socket.destroy BEFORE constructing a WebSocket (registered agents NOT counted — the slot frees on register). On register: protocolVersion!==PROTOCOL_VERSION -> register:nack VERSION_MISMATCH + close + no registration (log warn); invalid token (agentAuth.validate) -> register:nack AUTH_FAILED + close + no registration; success -> registry.register(...), register:ack {serverTime, heartbeatSec}, heartbeat/ping timers start only now. Post-auth: heartbeat -> heartbeat:ack; every other frame -> registry.handleFrame; close/error -> clear heartbeat timer + registry.markOffline. Never logs token/url — only { path, agentId, authed }. `handleSocket(socket: GatewaySocket)` and `pendingSockets()` are public for test injection. Server boot wires: `new AgentGateway({ server, registry, tokens, wsPath: config.AGENT_WS_PATH, logger })` on the shared http.Server (WsHub already yields on non-/ws; config guard forbids AGENT_WS_PATH==='/ws').

No new runtime dependency added (uses existing ws, zod). PM2 import site untouched. Standalone (MODE unset) path unchanged (new code is server-only; aliasSchema addition to schemas.ts is additive).
